usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and DocuSeal creates a document template from them through “Create Template from HTML”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Template from HTML” in DocuSeal
bestTemplate.why: A new product can get its own agreement template, built from HTML, ready for future signatures.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a template built from it follows a scheduled check.
